title: advance_state_counter_in_tx: undetected missing row returns stale counter
description: In lib.rs advance_state_counter_in_tx (line 635-647), the UPDATE statement's affected-row count is discarded. If type_name does not match any row in state_counters (e.g. due to a typo or a future refactor that adds a new counter type without seeding it), the UPDATE silently changes 0 rows, the subsequent SELECT returns the unchanged counter, and the function returns the pre-increment value as the new version. Two successive messages would then receive the same state_version, making JMAP /changes responses incorrect. The function is currently only called with hardcoded literals ('message', 'chat'), so the bug cannot trigger today, but there is no assertion guarding against it. Fix: check affected > 0 and return KithError::Store if the counter row is absent.
